newsitem.title: USA: Post Properties prices $125 mln debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Post Properties prices $125 mln debt offer.

text.p: Post Properties Inc said on Wednesday its Post Apartment Homes LP unit has priced a $125 million senior unsecured debt offering.
The debt was composed of a $100 million tranche of 7.25 percent notes due 2003 and a second tranche of $25 million of 7.50 percent notes, Post Properties said.
The $100 million of 7.25 percent was priced at 99.642 percent of par to yield 7.316 percent, or 71 basis points over comparable maturity U.S. Treasury securities.
The $25 million of 7.50 percent notes was priced at 99.694 percent of par to yield 7.544 percent, or 83 basis points over comparable U.S. Treasury securities.
Merrill Lynch & Co, J.P. Morgan Securities and Dean Witter Reynolds were managing underwriters for the offering, Post Properties said.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to retire interim debt on the company's unsecured revolving credit facility, Post Properties said.
